high_level_description: The image depicts a modern architectural structure with a contemporary design, set against a backdrop of a partly cloudy sky during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, given the warm tones in the sky. The building features a two-story design with large overhanging roofs supported by concrete pillars. The upper level has wooden shutters covering the windows, and there is a balcony with railings that extends along the length of the building. In front of the building, there is a rectangular swimming pool with clear water, reflecting the sky above.
